{{Quote|Fyrel Cannor, holo-editor for the Nova. Good to meet you.|Fyrel Cannor|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Fyrel Cannor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a holo-editor for the [[Nova (news network)|Nova]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War|Civil War]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. He was present in [[King's Pass]] where he tasked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizen to escort a junior reporter through an Ulgo-controlled area to take pictures and report on the war crimes taking place there.<ref name="TOR" />
